figures.caption: Figure 1: Contrastive privacy versus utility (as similarity) for a variety of mechanisms sanitizing: (top) the identity of the fast food restaurant from 49 images; (bottom) the movie discussed in the passage from 49 text passages. Pareto dominant mechanisms have square markers. (Note the different axes for each figure.)
Figure 8: The most significant privacy failure for mechanism GPT54 using the distance mechanism QWEN3 on the 49 comment Avengers dataset.
Figure 14: The most significant privacy failures for 49 images capturing the McDonald’s brand and sanitizing the abstract concept the identity of the fast food restaurant.

Figure 2: Contrastive privacy measures success via Inequality 4, D(Xc(x),y)+δ > D(Xc(x),Xc(y)). (red/blue for clarity.) For sanitizing the concept of celebrities (distance via EVA-CLIP-18B), the privacy test detects: (a) success for iGEM31f (at resolution δ = 0); and (b) failure for FLX2d/GEM31p (at resolution δ = 0.11).
Figure 12: A privatized collection of 49 images depicting the McDonald’s restaurant. Resolutions are calculated using the EVA distance mechanism.
Figure 10: An attempt to sanitize the concept the identity of the fast food restaurant from a collection of nine images capturing the brand McDonald’s.

Figure 4: (left) 30 images capturing Leonard DiCaprio sanitized of the identity of the celebrities by (center) iGPT1m/GEM31p, privacy resolution 0.02 and utility 0.42; (right) iGEM31f/Manual, privacy resolution 0 and utility 0.61, where D is EVA for both.

Figure 5: Privacy resolution and utility for 30 images capturing Leonardo DiCaprio sanitized of the identity of the celebrities. Diagonal cells: privacy resolution (red) and utility (blue); lighter color is better. Black-framed cells are Pareto optimal. Red-framed cells failed to sanitize one image due to model safeguards.

Figure 6: Privacy resolution (red) and utility (blue) from sanitizing the concept the identity of the fast food restaurant from 49 images of McDonald’s. (Data is the same as Figure 1a. Formatting is same as Figure 5.

Figure 13: The most significant privacy failures for 30 images capturing Leonardo DiCaprio and sanitizing the abstract concept the identity of the celebrities. Empty cells indicate that the mechanism achieved contrastive privacy at resolution 0 according to distance mechanism EVA.
Table 2: Distance and Sanitization Mechanisms. SAM3 sets the following parameters: threshold = 0.2, blur = 5, and dilate = 25. GLN2 sets threshold = 0.05.
